formation.method: single-phase equilibrium at the phase's low-T composition, 298.15 K; dfS = S - sum x_i S_i(SER); SER entropies from unary equilibria at 298.15 K

method.grid: same composition-set-aware grid as the field map
method.stability_limits: grid limit snapped to an invariant/congruent/melting T within one grid step, otherwise bisection to 0.01 K at a fixed composition

mixing_table.partials: H_i - H_i(pure liquid) from central differences of the integral HM_MIX (h = 1e-4)
mixing_table.reference: pure liquid A and B at T

phase_stability.T_high_source: maximum over composition at x(Ni) = 1e-05 (golden-section in x, bisection 0.01 K)
